exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: faithful Silent Storm painted equipment diffuse UV bitmap.

Input image1 is the EXACT complete original storedRGB source exposed only by whole NEAREST source-only enlargement. Faithfully refine the same entire source paint at higher resolution, very subtly. The entire bitmap remains edge-to-edge, same aspect/normalized UV, all black/shadow/gap areas, original marks/count/scale/phase/colors and local weak tonal hierarchy. Flat UV artwork, not an object photograph. Original sourceA is independently retained and brightness globally calibrated numerically.

Keep EXACT FOUR original main bitmap groups: upper-left broad soft brown field; upper-middle narrower soft brown field with exactly ONE existing very darkbrown flat round paint spot(source RGB16/12/8, alpha255); right dark blue-gray field with original fine diagonal/curving painted streaks; and lower-left ONE narrow elongated gray field with its original small bright/dark paint segments. Preserve every source boundary/gap/streak position and the fine original streak count/phase/direction/scale from image1. Brown fields remain the same softly painted matte source, not physical coarsecloth/weave/embroidered seams. Right painted streak field stays the SAME original density/brightness, no invented new fibers/threads/rays or thicker grooves. The source dim brown spot stays dim and flat, not a newly black punched hole, no new metallic rim or bolt. Lower gray stroke retains original pale weak marks with exactly existing widths, not sharpened knife/needle/hardware. Do not invent any anatomy, tools or symbol from ambiguous source patterns.

Maintain original matte paint and softly shaded gray/brown/color fields at the source grain frequency. Preserve existing weak pale paint, dark areas and original outlines without turning them into brightmetal/glintyrod/raised bevel/rims/newhardware/bolts/straps/embossed lettering/physical coarsegrain/etched scratches/photo weave/rust chunks/pores. No new parts, seams, folds, dents, holes, markings/text or stronger specular highlights. Do not regularize tiny native phases or idealize source asymmetry.

Output the ENTIRE opaque storedRGB texture canvas only; exact original composition and source material softness. No crop/BBox/zoom/padding/whiteframe/recentering/object render/cutout/registration/repacking. Alpha, native Type, runtime binding and sourceUV remain original.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST4x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.

pattern_constraints.before_prompt_proof: Executed original-only native field/count/phase and material/tone matrix proof BEFOREprompts/calls. Bboxes and threshold masks are numeric diagnostics only, NEVER cropped references or artistic sourceRGB inserts. No invented universal threshold or fake Model UV semantics. All sourceA255 actual, not inferred from Ordinary Type.

source_bitmap_fields.name: ONE upperleft broad matte brown field
ONE uppermiddle narrower brown field and ONE dark spot
ONE right finely streaked dark bluegray field
ONE lowerleft long narrow gray field

pattern_constraints.dark_spot_numeric_segmentation: Sourceobserved darkest spot RGBmax16..33 separated from surrounding source RGBmax>=51; <=33 derives THIS original source, not global acceptance threshold or alpha-hole claim.
pattern_constraints.unknowns: Native field labels are bitmap observations only. Thread/needle/hardware object interpretation and authored mesh UV are not inferred; keep exact original fine painted streak direction/count/phase/scale.
